thread:
sarah: Heads up — console quota by route in staging is ~20% higher than SDK-reported tokens. Can we triage?

mike: same, noticed at 09:10 while smoke-testing the billing flow.

jenn: is this the per-route attribution mismatch or double-counting from retries?

oliver: looks like attribution: console is grouping by `route:legacy` while SDKs started sending `route:compact` in the new header.

dena: oh — we changed the Python SDK to emit `X-Route-Header: compact/v2` last week. TS/Go still `legacy` until next patch.

jonas: can we normalize on the server side (console ingestion) to map both? quick patch might fix dashboards fast.

mike: normalization hack is ok short-term but we should avoid long-term server-side heuristics. We need a consistent canonical route id across pipeline.

jenn: agree. proposal: console ingestion accepts both, but we add a migration flag `rc.route_canonicalize=true` and log differences to `route-mismatch` audit stream for 48h.

oliver: that buy us time while SDKs converge. timeline for SDK parity?

dena: Python -> done. TS has PR open (ts-sdk#432). Go needs a small change (go-sdk#221). Can schedule TS + Go patch tomorrow.

sarah: ok plan: 1) enable canonicalize flag in staging now, 2) wait 24h to confirm reduction in dashboard drift, 3) roll to prod with 7-day rollback window.

jonas: add a console tile showing `route_mismatch_rate` so SRE can watch. low-effort: reuse existing telemetry stream.

mike: telemetry question: do SDKs send sampling metadata? if some clients sample spans differently we could still under/over count.

dena: TS/Go currently don't include sampling bits in the header. Python includes `X-Sample-Mode` for debug. We should standardize a `sampling=auto|force|none` field in header.

jenn: +1 to standardize. but we can't land that in ingestion at same time as canonicalization or it'll conflate. separate rollout.

sarah: agree separate. for now canonicalize headers mapping + mismatch audit, SDK owners to finish header parity in 48h, then follow-up on sampling field spec.

oliver: minor SDK breaking-change note: the TS PR renames `client.routeHint` -> `client.route` (more explicit). Need to call out in changelog and bump major?

dena: it's additive if we keep legacy alias for one release. let's do deprecation path: alias, warn, then remove. non-breaking for users if alias present.

mike: console: when alias present we should prefer new param but still attribute to legacy id until all SDKs flip. we need an attribution precedence doc.

jenn: I'll draft precedence: `explicit header > client.route (new) > client.routeHint (legacy) > fallback-inference`. Put in design-docs and link from changelogs.

sarah: sounds good. also set a telemetry spike alert if `route_mismatch_rate > 0.5%` for 3m. set it in staging first.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: enable `rc.route_canonicalize=true` in staging at 6998765475 by sarah.

mike: confirm applied, seeing immediate drop from 19% -> 4% (very rough). will watch next hour. :eyes:

jonas: thanks, team. after SDK parity and sampling spec we can remove the canonicalize flag and make canonicalization explicit in console ingest code.

sarah: next actions: jenn write precedence doc, dena coordinate TS/Go PRs, oliver add console tile/watch, mike observe staging metrics, I'll own prod rollout and rollback window.

dena: filing issues for TS/Go and adding changelog notes now.

mike: posting quick note to #product-billing to set expectations about minor dashboard noise over next 48h.

sarah: thanks everyone.
